command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='crates/wasmi/src/coredump.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("use alloc::{format, string::String, vec, vec::Vec};", "use alloc::{format, string::String, vec::Vec};")
s=s.replace('let executable_name = store.engine().config().get_coredump_executable_name().to_owned();',
            'let executable_name = String::from(store.engine().config().get_coredump_executable_name());')
s=s.replace(".position(|i| i as *const InstanceEntity as usize == ptr)",
            ".position(|i| (*i) as *const InstanceEntity as usize == ptr)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='crates/wasmi/src/module/mod.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("use alloc::{boxed::Box, string::String, sync::Arc, vec::Vec};", "use alloc::{boxed::Box, string::String, sync::Arc};")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PYEOF
grep -n "use alloc" crates/wasmi/src/coredump.rs crates/wasmi/src/module/mod.rs | head
